image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a single sesame seed bagel resting on a dark, metallic surface (likely a pan or plate). The bagel is golden-brown with a glossy crust and is heavily topped with white sesame seeds. The central hole is visible but partially obscured by the angle and shadows. The lighting creates strong highlights on the glaze and seeds.
